open_points: The story lane's paper (production/lane/story/paper/) had not landed when this file was made: every line here is replaced by its scenes when it does.
note: Story-carrying lines. The words given are the frame's sample lines (not final script), kept so the one-shot has them; every bank the story needs is listed as TO WRITE for the story lane, whose scenes outrank these.

lines.text: Coming up on the ice house. That's the ice house. Leaving the ice house.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: I've told her nowt that isn't so. I've just not told her you.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Aye. Well. Envelope still wants carrying.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: The book will hide ten pounds and four fifths of what the cars really drove. Past that I'm not keeping accounts, love, I'm writing you a reference.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Thirty-one years I've written what I was told. You write this one.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Every fare goes in the book. That was Mickey's rule, and it's mine now. So. What was last night?
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Same as your first night?
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: He's moved my motor. Mickey would've asked nicely for a fortnight and then said sorry.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: You've got the book, nephew. I am the book.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: That's how you park it.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: I never ask anybody for anything, Mr Nowak. I find out what they're short of.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Sit down. It's been in the oven twice.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: I'm not asking you to remember everything. I'm asking you to remember it the same way twice.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Somebody always saw, Mr Nowak. My trouble is finding the one who'll sign.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Write it again. Underneath. Same words.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: That you, boss? Say nowt.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Saying's nowt, boss. You've a firm to stand in. I've a door.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Tell him it's five minutes fast. Mickey liked to be early.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: You keep that rank going, boss. I've not sat in here for you to finish with nowt.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: Eighty pound, Mr Nowak. I've your change here.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)

lines.text: That's us straight.
lines.src: STORY-FRAME-2026-11-26 (sample line, not final script: the story lane owns it)
